verdict.rationale: Clerk ships an official CLI (init, deploy, impersonate, local webhook relay) and personal access tokens for its Backend API. Its llms.txt says the CLI needs no global install, API keys, or sign-in, and agents can provision an accountless app and keys. Together these suggest scriptable, headless use, but nothing documents CI pipelines or non-interactive CLI flags. missing for 10: explicit headless/CI mode documentation for the CLI, non-interactive auth/flag guidance for pipelines, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
